'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey there, warrior. Still fighting? Good. There is this job, a cakewalk, really. Obviously, not of your caliber, it's gonna be a favor, so to say. I've received an order, they need some 60-rounders for 5.45 AKs. I know there definitely were some in bunkers near the sawmill, my guys stashed some goods there before. But they got driven out of there by those TerraGroup people, who then locked the bunkers with a key of some sort. Well, if you're going for the bunker, you'll need that key, I think it's hidden somewhere in dorms on Customs, people have seen some TerraGroup brass there a couple of times. Anyway, I don't care where you find them, but I need you to get them fresh and untouched by some traders. And hurry up, the order is urgent.}}

==Requirements==
* Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with [[Prapor]] to obtain this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 3 [[AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine]]s [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
** (''Optional'') Obtain the [[ZB-014 key|key to the bunker]] in the [[Dorm room 220 key|TerraGroup employee's dorm room]]
** (''Optional'') Locate the [[ZB-014 key|locked bunker]] on [[Woods]]
* Hand over the [[AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine|items]]

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.25'''</font>
* 165,000 Roubles
** 173,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 189,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Well, they say money can't buy friendship, but I still owe you.}}

==Initial Equipment==
Unlocks craft for [[AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Lavatory level 1]].

The locked [[ZB-014 key|ZB-014 bunker]] on [[Woods]] mentioned by [[Prapor]] does '''not''' have a guaranteed or increased spawn chance for the wanted magazines.

Obtaining them from weapon boxes, green wooden crates or bosses and their guards, for example [[Sanitar]] is usually way more reliable.
